definitions.chart_basis: Astrologer works from the D1 rasi chart (plus nakshatra lords); bhava-chalit shifts not used.
definitions.core_principle: A planet in 6/8/12 is not automatically 'hidden' or harmful. Its dasa succeeds if EITHER (a) that house's lord is strong (own/exalted, or the stated special strength) OR (b) Jupiter aspects. Even long runs of dusthana dasas (decades) can be highly successful.
definitions.dasa_gate: Good or bad combinations only act in their own dasa/bhukti; transits only trigger what the dasa allows.

rules.name: Dusthana dasa success test
rules.condition: dasa of a planet placed in 6, 8 or 12

branches.if: lord of that house own/exalted OR Jupiter aspects the house/planet
branches.then: Dasa succeeds
Dasa likely difficult
Goes abroad for work
Goes abroad definitely; lives comfortably there

branches.if: lord_6 own/exalted (e.g. Jupiter for Kadagam lagna)
branches.then: Abroad brings hardship; better to stay
Own business succeeds strongly; unbeatable in competition (monopoly/pioneer)
Employment in a top-priority role, not business
Yoga - lends money to others rather than borrowing
Hardship in its dasa: finances (young adult), health (elderly), family strain (child)
Textbook negative (losses, domestic trouble)
Turns into yoga - e.g. 8th lord retrograde in 4th: property and vehicles

branches.if: lord_12 own/exalted, or with own/exalted planet, or in 6/8/12 in own sign
branches.then: Very prosperous dasa: household goods, vehicles, property

branches.if: lord_12 retrograde or debilitated and not connected to Rahu/Ketu
branches.then: Severe financial hardship; struggles to keep word

rules.name: Stellium in 12th with lord_12 own sign
rules.condition: lord_12 in its own sign in 12th with other planets
rules.result: None of those planets count as hidden - every one of their dasas becomes a yoga dasa (e.g. foreign education/settlement, financial success). Venus retrograde there is still fine if Ketu is with it; without Ketu, retrograde lord_12 spoils the combination.

rules.name: Strong lord_12 outside 12th
rules.condition: lord_12 strong in kendra/trikona, or retrograde with Rahu/Ketu
rules.result: Dasa of a planet sitting in 12th (e.g. lone Rahu) can still be yogic.

rules.name: Adhi yoga
rules.condition: Benefics in 6th, 7th and 8th from the Moon
rules.result: Adhi yoga, prosperity, comforts, victory over opponents.

rules.name: Moon in 6th via lagna-lord star
rules.condition: Moon in 6th (even with Rahu) in the nakshatra of an own-sign lagna lord

rules.name: Kendradhipatya dosha exceptions
rules.dosha_cases: Benefic owning two kendras placed own-sign in one of them (Jupiter for Kanni 4th/7th, Mithunam 7th/10th; Mercury for Meenam 4th/7th, Dhanusu 7th/10th).
rules.exception: Lagna lord in Lagna does NOT give kendradhipatya dosha (Jupiter for Dhanusu/Meenam, Mercury for Mithunam/Kanni in Lagna).

branches.then: Debts likely during its dasa
Good earnings during its dasa

branches.if: Mars retrograde in an earth sign
branches.then: Property comes, but with a flaw (power line/pylon across it)
Property near a large water body

branches.if: Mars neither retrograde nor own/exalted AND its dispositor weak
branches.then: Property purchases become a burden
Top-grade yoga
Good yoga
Moderate yoga

branches.if: Mars or Rahu dasa never runs
branches.then: No effect; property via other dasas

rules.name: Sun-Mars and mangalya
rules.result: No marital (mangalya) dosha if either Sun or Mars is in own sign or exalted (Mesha, Simha, Vrischika, Makara). A strong 8th lord (own sign) also strengthens the marital bond.
